title: Eliminate Maximum Number of Monsters
problemStatement: Each monster starts at a certain distance from the city and moves toward it at a constant speed. Every minute, you may eliminate exactly one monster before any monster reaches the city. Determine the maximum number of monsters that can be eliminated.
input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains N integers representing distances. • Third line contains N integers representing speeds.
output: Print the maximum number of monsters that can be eliminated.
